as_told.title: Prince Hans-Adam convened the Roswell witnesses

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Hans-Adam, the prince of Liechtenstein, a small European country, once brought together all the witnesses to the Roswell event, the 1947 New Mexico case many believe was a crashed craft. In one telling Michels says he heard this from a man he interviewed, John Brandenburg, and places it around the 1970s or 1980s; in another he links it to a writer, Whitley Strieber, and gives no date. If true, it would show a European royal taking a private, serious interest in the case.
